% A guard: it checks a case that the fix of the files read with the
% primitive \input must not break.
% contour's dvips.cnt, from TeX's tree, read with the primitive \input.
% The file names itself \ProvidesFile{dvips.cnt}, so tex4ht reads
% dvips.4ht, which the TeX log lists. As in the PDF, the page builds.
% One rule alone leaves the name unmarked: it is found in TeX's tree and
% not beside the document. Its extension, .cnt, is not a package's, and no
% package reads a dvips file first, so the document loads no color or
% graphics package.
\documentclass{article}
\makeatletter
\input dvips.cnt
\makeatother
\begin{document}
Text after the contour driver file.
\end{document}
